behavior.A8L8: B/R repeat the low byte, G/A repeat the high byte

behavior.A16L16: B/R repeat the low 16 bits, G/A repeat the high 16 bits

evidence: Native 0x696C producer selects both packed lanes through B/G.

tests: A16 native remap yields (1,scalar,1,1), correcting the earlier synthetic zero-lane assumption.
